name: Muñico (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag with a white inner border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Muñico (a tree and a black wolf on white).
history: The arms of Muñico were approved on 30 March 2011 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 128 of 4 July 2011).

features.role: Muñico arms — tree and wolf on white
